t2.title: Children be encouraged to read books more
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "How can children be encouraged to read books more?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Turning Pages: How to Get Children Reading

In an age dominated by screens and digital entertainment, encouraging children to read books has become increasingly challenging. However, there are several effective strategies that can help.

Firstly, parents should lead by example. When children see adults reading regularly, they are more likely to develop an interest themselves. Creating a reading routine, such as bedtime stories, can establish positive habits from an early age.

Additionally, allowing children to choose their own books is crucial. Forcing them to read specific titles may create resistance. Libraries and bookstores offer diverse selections that cater to various interests, from adventure stories to science books.

Furthermore, schools could organize reading competitions and book clubs to make reading a social activity. Rewards and recognition can motivate reluctant readers.

Finally, limiting screen time and creating a cozy reading space at home can make books more appealing. With patience and the right approach, we can nurture a love of reading that lasts a lifetime.

t2.sampleB1:
Dear Student Magazine Editor,

I want to write about how to make children read more books. I think it is important because reading is good for your brain.

First, parents can read to their children. This makes reading fun. Also, children should choose their own books. If they like the books, they will read them more. For example, my little brother likes comic books, so he reads a lot. Schools can also help. They can have reading clubs. In my opinion, this is a good idea because children can talk about books together.

In conclusion, reading is important, and we should help children to read more. Thank you.

Sincerely,
A Student
t2.sampleB2: Hooked on Books: Getting Kids to Read These days, with screens grabbing children's attention at every turn, getting them to pick up a book can feel like an uphill battle. Yet with a little effort, we can help young readers fall in love with stories. To begin with, children should be free to choose what they read. Rather than forcing them through classics they find dull, we ought to let them explore comics, adventure tales or anything that sparks their curiosity. Once a child finds a book they enjoy, they will happily read on their own. Secondly, adults play a huge part. When parents read regularly and share bedtime stories, children naturally follow suit. Setting up a cosy reading corner at home, well away from distractions, makes a real difference too. Finally, schools can bring reading to life through book clubs, author visits and friendly reading challenges. Turning it into a shared, social activity takes the pressure off and makes it genuinely fun. In short, by giving children choice, good role models and a bit of encouragement, we can nurture a love of reading that stays with them for life.
t2.uzSample:
Sahifalarni varaqlash: Bolalarni kitob o'qishga qanday undash mumkin

Ekranlar va raqamli o'yin-kulgi hukmronlik qilayotgan davrda bolalarni kitob o'qishga undash tobora qiyinlashib bormoqda. Biroq, bunga yordam beradigan bir nechta samarali strategiyalar mavjud.

Birinchidan, ota-onalar o'zlari namuna bo'lishlari kerak. Bolalar kattalarning muntazam ravishda o'qiyotganini ko'rsalar, ularda ham qiziqish uyg'onishi ehtimoli yuqori. Yotishdan oldin ertak o'qib berish kabi o'qish odatini yaratish, erta yoshdan ijobiy odatlarni shakllantirishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, bolalarga o'z kitoblarini tanlashga ruxsat berish juda muhim. Ularni muayyan kitoblarni o'qishga majburlash qarshilikni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin. Kutubxonalar va kitob do'konlari sarguzasht hikoyalaridan tortib, ilmiy kitoblarga qadar turli xil qiziqishlarga mos keladigan xilma-xil tanlovlarni taklif etadi.

Bundan tashqari, maktablar o'qishni ijtimoiy faoliyatga aylantirish uchun o'qish tanlovlari va kitob klublarini tashkil qilishi mumkin. Mukofotlar va e'tiroflar o'qishga ishtiyoqi yo'q o'quvchilarni rag'batlantirishi mumkin.

Va nihoyat, ekran vaqtini cheklash va uyda qulay o'qish joyini yaratish kitoblarni yanada jozibador qilishi mumkin. Sabr-toqat va to'g'ri yondashuv bilan biz umr bo'yi davom etadigan kitobga muhabbatni rivojlantirishimiz mumkin.

Salom!

Kitob do'koni yaxshi. Kitoblar yaxshi. Xodimlar yaxshi. Menga kitoblar yoqadi. O'qish burchagi yaxshi. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,

Menga kitob do'koni yoqadi. Kitoblar yaxshi va men ularni topdim. Xodimlar yaxshi va ular menga yordam berishdi. Menga o'qish burchagi yoqadi, u qulay. Men ko'proq kitob o'qishni xohlayman! Rahmat.

Xayr.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli Talabalar Jurnali Muharriri,

Men bolalarni qanday qilib ko'proq kitob o'qishga undash haqida yozmoqchiman. O'ylashimcha, bu muhim, chunki o'qish miya uchun foydali.

Birinchidan, ota-onalar farzandlariga kitob o'qib berishlari mumkin. Bu o'qishni qiziqarli qiladi. Shuningdek, bolalar o'z kitoblarini tanlashlari kerak. Agar ularga kitoblar yoqsa, ular ularni ko'proq o'qiydilar. Misol uchun, mening ukam komikslarni yaxshi ko'radi, shuning uchun u ko'p o'qiydi. Maktablar ham yordam berishi mumkin. Ular kitobxonlik klublariga ega bo'lishlari mumkin. Mening fikrimcha, bu yaxshi fikr, chunki bolalar birgalikda kitoblar haqida gaplashishlari mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, o'qish muhim va biz bolalarga ko'proq o'qishga yordam berishimiz kerak. Rahmat.

Hurmat bilan,
Talaba
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli Talabalar Jurnali Muharriri,

Bolalarni ko'proq kitob o'qishga qanday undashimiz mumkinligi haqidagi fikrlarim quyidagilar. Bugungi kunda video o'yinlar va ijtimoiy tarmoqlardan shunchalik ko'p raqobat bor ekan, bu haqiqiy muammo.

Birinchidan, o'qishni qiziqarli va ijobiy tajribaga aylantirish muhim. Bolalarni zerikarli deb biladigan kitoblarni o'qishga majburlash o'rniga, ularga chinakam qiziq bo'lgan kitoblarni tanlashga ruxsat berishimiz kerak. Komikslar, grafik romanlar va hatto jurnallar ham ajoyib boshlanish bo'lishi mumkin. Ikkinchidan, ota-onalar va o'qituvchilar namuna bo'lishlari kerak. Agar bolalar kattalarning muntazam ravishda o'qiyotganini va bundan zavqlanayotganini ko'rsalar, ularda ham shunga o'xshash odat paydo bo'lishi ehtimoli ko'proq. Uyda chalg'ituvchi narsalardan xoli bo'lgan maxsus o'qish joyini yaratish ham katta farq qilishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, maktablar kitob klublari, mualliflar tashrifi va o'qish bo'yicha musobaqalarni tashkil etish orqali muhim rol o'ynashi mumkin. Ushbu tadbirlar hamjamiyat tuyg'usini shakllantirishi va o'qishni yanada ijtimoiy va qiziqarli faoliyatga aylantirishi mumkin. Nihoyat, har bir bola har xil ekanligini unutmaslik kerak. Ba'zi bolalar yolg'iz o'qishni afzal ko'rishlari mumkin, boshqalari esa guruhda yaxshi rivojlanishlari mumkin. O'qish uchun turli xil imkoniyatlarni taklif qilish va qo'llab-quvvatlovchi muhit yaratish orqali biz barcha bolalarga o'qish zavqini kashf etishga yordam beramiz.

Hurmat bilan,
Xavotirdagi Talaba

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who also goes to this bookstore. Write about your feelings and what you think the bookstore management should do.
t11.sample: Hey! I just got an email from our favorite bookstore asking for feedback. Honestly, I really love the place, but finding specific books can be tricky. I think they should add more clear signage. Have you tried their new reading corner? It's so cozy! Let me know your thoughts!
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Malika,
Bookstore! I go. Books... hard to find. Staff... okay. Bye.
t11.sampleA2:

t11.sampleB1:

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the bookstore. Write about your feelings and what you think the bookstore management should do.
t12.sample:
Dear Bookstore Team,

Thank you for asking for my feedback. I am a regular customer and thoroughly enjoy visiting your store.

Firstly, regarding finding books, I would suggest improving the signage system. While your collection is impressive, locating specific titles can be somewhat challenging without staff assistance.

Additionally, I must commend your staff for their friendly service and extensive knowledge. They are always willing to help and offer excellent recommendations.

Furthermore, I was pleasantly surprised by your new reading corner. It provides a peaceful atmosphere perfect for browsing. Perhaps adding some comfortable seating would enhance the experience further.

Thank you for your dedication to creating a wonderful bookstore.

Kind regards,
A Loyal Customer

Hi Bookstore,


I like books. Find book ok. Staff good. Read corner? Yes. Good.


Bye.

Dear Bookstore,


Thank you for the email. I come to your shop. It is good. I find books, but it is a little hard. The staff are nice and they help me. The reading corner is okay, but it is small. Maybe you can make it bigger? Thank you.


From, Doston Karimov

The staff were very friendly and helpful, so that was good. I also liked the reading corner. It was quiet. However, maybe you could add more chairs? In my opinion, that would be better. t12.sampleB2: Dear Bookstore Team, Thank you for reaching out for feedback following my recent visit. On the whole, I thoroughly enjoyed my time in your store, though I would like to share a few thoughts. Firstly, while your collection is impressive, I found it rather difficult to locate the titles I was after. Clearer signage would make a real difference and help customers find their way around more easily. On a more positive note, your staff were friendly and remarkably knowledgeable. They went out of their way to point me in the right direction and suggested several books I would never have found otherwise. Finally, I was pleasantly surprised by your new reading corner. It offers a peaceful atmosphere, and a little more comfortable seating would round it off nicely. Thank you for taking my comments on board. Yours faithfully, Dilnoza Karimova

Birinchidan, kitoblar tanlovi maqtashga arziydigan bo'lsa-da, do'konda yo'l topish biroz qiyin bo'ldi. Joriy ko'rsatkichlarni muayyan janrlar yoki mualliflarni osonroq topishga yordam berish uchun yaxshilash mumkin. Aniqroq va ko'zga tashlanadigan displeylar foydali bo'ladi.

Hurmat bilan,
Doston Karimov

tasks.p1_context: You received this email from a local bookstore.
tasks.p1_scenario:
Dear Customer,

Thank you for coming to our bookstore today. We hope you enjoyed your visit!
Could you tell us how easy it was to find the books you were looking for?
We are also interested in hearing about your communication with our staff. Were they friendly and knowledgeable?
Lastly, did you have time to try our new reading corner? If so, what did you think of it?
Your feedback will help us improve.

The Bookstore Team
